messages:
seank: Kicking off staged rollout for service=api-gateway, release v2.3.1 -> 10% global sample now. will watch latency/5xx for 30m. deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] canary started id=canary-1778889990; target 10% traffic; strategy=staged-sample.

deploy-bot: command executed: `redwoodctl rollout start --service api-gateway --version v2.3.1 --sample 10% --strategy staged-sample`

maya_oncall: :warning: seeing uptick in 502/503 from eu-west within the first 5m. spike from 0.2% -> 1.8% on auth-proxy upstream, not model pods. tailing logs now.

seank: thanks maya. holding ramp. pausing rollout now.

deploy-bot: [AUTOMATION] rollout paused by @seank. canary id=canary-1778889990 state=paused at 10%

jonah: suggestion — pin eu-west to previous version (v2.3.0) while infra digs in. This isolates the region and keeps global sample stable.

seank: agreed. applying pin for eu-west. command: `redwoodctl routing pin --service api-gateway --region eu-west --version v2.3.0`

ops-bot: action log: routing.pin executed by seank; region=eu-west; pinned_version=v2.3.0; timestamp=1778890205

maya_oncall: quick debug: the new gateway change adds `Connection: close` header under certain upstream timeouts -> downstream LB retries are tripping and causing 502s. looking at PR #1087 which introduced header logic.

clara: putting this in the release notes thread: https://redwood.in/releases/2.3.1 — will mark the gateway header as a known issue and note the rollback/pin. change window proposed for reattempt: 2026-03-24 10:00-11:00 UTC (controlled ramp with infra oncall).

jonah: we should also tag builds and add a quick e2e smoke for auth-proxy. I can open a hotfix revert PR and run a mini canary in eu-west only.

seank: plan: 1) paused global ramp (done). 2) eu-west pinned to v2.3.0 (done). 3) jonah to land revert PR and run eu-west mini canary in change window. 4) ops to monitor auth-proxy 5xx for 2h after pin. if stable, we resume staged rollout in change window and proceed with gradual ramp.

maya_oncall: monitoring dashboards now — will post snapshots if anything changes. so far error rate dropped back to baseline ~0.25% after pin.

deploy-bot: Rollout summary: canary-1778889990 status=paused; global_traffic=10%; pinned_regions=[eu-west->v2.3.0]; actions=[pause, pin].

seank: TL;DR: paused and pinned, follow-up tomorrow during change window. thanks all. :thumbsup:

clara: adding note to release-triage and product owners. will update docs and release page after revert PR lands.

deploy-bot: closing thread for active rollout actions. use `redwoodctl rollout resume --id canary-1778889990` in change window to continue.
